title: A gallery entry: entries/<id>.json
description: tools/lib/entry.mjs is what the checks run; this file is for editors and for reading.

license.description: An SPDX id. Required for an example kept in this repository, whose directory then holds a LICENSE with that text; for a design in another repository it replaces the licence of the repository (a reviewer checks it).

source.description: A public GitHub repository at one commit. Leave it out for an example kept in this repository, in examples/<id>/.

entry.description: The netlist the Viewer opens, relative to the repository (or to examples/<id>/).

paths.description: Directories searched for include files given by name only, in order. Default: the entry's directory.

add.description: Files or directories to add besides what the netlist includes (a directory is taken with what is below it).

packages.description: Packages to load: from the public catalog, a file of the repository, or a raw.githubusercontent.com address.

level.description: The level drawn as the thumbnail and shown first: a subcircuit name, or "(top)" for the netlist's own. Default: the first that draws something.
